text: {"lessons":["Selling positions simply to lock in gains can leave me focused on each stock’s purchase price rather than my overall account and future prospects.","Holding through losses to avoid the pain of realizing them is still a decision; I should reassess positions instead of letting my reluctance to sell dictate it.","Since past price changes do not predict future ones, I should not expect recent declines to reverse—or recent gains to continue—and should make each period’s choices deliberately."]}
